title: Augmented Reality
tagline: Add a digital layer to reality.
shortDescription: Point a phone at a product, a poster, a menu, or a space, and a digital layer appears on top of it: animations, explanations, characters, or whole rooms, right where they belong.
longDescription: A modular AR layer that places digital content onto the real world through the visitor's own phone or a dedicated screen. A drinks can grows a jungle and a mascot, a menu turns into floating 3D dishes, a device shows step-by-step instructions on its own buttons, a doorway opens into a furnished room, and face filters put visitors into the story. It works for playful discovery, product explanation, spatial storytelling, and education, and reveals more without adding physical clutter. Triggers, content, and look are configurable, from a single product to a whole exhibition. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Products That Explain Themselves
highlights.description: Point the phone at a device, a package, or a menu and the explanation appears right on it: which button to press, what is inside, or what the dish looks like. Ideal for retail and product launches.

highlights.title: Bigger Than the Space
highlights.description: Show a full-size room, a machine, or a scene that would never fit on a stand. A doorway or a marker on the floor becomes the entrance to a whole digital world.

highlights.title: On the Phone They Already Have
highlights.description: Visitors scan a code and start, with no hardware to hand out. That keeps costs low and lets the experience travel beyond the venue, onto packaging, posters, or printed invitations.

highlights.title: New Ways to Trigger
highlights.description: Add face filters that put visitors into the story, a collect-them-all hunt across several markers, a physical miniature that comes alive when scanned, or a shared view on a big screen.

highlights.title: A Layer for Every Story
highlights.description: Let a mascot pop out of a drink for a brand campaign, show how a castle looked centuries ago in a museum, furnish an empty showroom, or add snow and lights to a winter edition.

highlights.title: See What People Point At
highlights.description: Add a data layer that counts scans per marker, time spent with each scene, and shares of filter photos, so the client knows which products and stories drew the most attention.

highlights.title: A Layer Over the Whole Visit
highlights.description: Pair with Trail / Scavenger Hunt to hide AR clues along a route, with Objects Recognition to trigger content from real objects, or with Memory Catcher to save AR moments as photos.
